subject: Post-call: ownership mapping + legal queue for MedTech Labs
body:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Praveen Singh <praveen@medtechlabs.com>; Asha Kapoor <asha.kapoor@medtechlabs.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Feb 2028 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap + next-step owners (shot across)

Hi Praveen / Asha — great call today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) Decision criteria (what you highlighted): inference latency, predictable monthly unit costs, private deployment option for PHI.
2) Economic buyer: you mentioned CFO-sponsorship; please confirm name/target date.
3) Security & procurement flow: Asha, you indicated Legal + Procurement sign-off required; would Procurement own MSA/DPA routing?
4) Pilot timeline: try for a 6-week POC, start in April.

Action items I propose:
- Praveen: confirm economic buyer and their preferred date for a short sync with Ben.
- Asha: please share procurement contact and any specific redline constraints (insurance, indemnity caps, data residency).
- Hannah (CC): I will coordinate legal queue and CS evidence requests.

Attachments: none in this message.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

Markus — forwarding MedTech’s MSA draft and the call notes. High level:
- Economic buyer: Mira Patel (VP Finance) — plan a 30-min cost walkthrough the week of Mar 6.
- Procurement POC: Samir Shah (procurement@medtechlabs.com).
- Legal prefers MSA first, DPA concurrently.

Could you advise:
1) Typical redline turnaround for a standard MSA (we expect non-enterprise unusual clauses) — target from our side and expected rounds.
2) Any quick blockers (data residency, indemnity caps) that would change the plan.

I attached the draft MSA they provided. Please add to the legal queue and confirm owner.

Thanks — Hannah

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Feb 2028 11:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Discovery recap + next-step owners (shot across) — request: redline lane & ETA

Thanks for the heads-up and forwarding the MSA. Quick read — a few items to flag immediately: 
- Indemnity / liability section: MedTech’s template includes uncapped liability for third-party claims in Section 9 — we will not accept uncapped exposure; propose a mutual cap tied to annual contract value.
- Data residency: their MSA references EEA processing in a single line; need clarification whether PHI will be stored/processed in US-only environment. If PHI is involved, we need the DPA and our privacy addendum reviewed in parallel.
- Insurance: they require higher limits than our standard; can likely accommodate but need procurement sign-off for any insurance load.

Turn times / lane: 
- Initial redline (legal review & proposed redline): 3 business days from when Legal receives the canonical MSA and Spec/POC scope.
- Expect 2–3 rounds of back-and-forth with their counsel; reserve 7–10 business days for negotiation cycles unless expedited.

Owner: I will own the MSA redline. Please route the canonical copy to legal@redwood.com and cc me. I’ll add comments inline and produce a short summary for Mira.

Markus Klein
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference

On Fri, 24 Feb 2028 12:02:00 -0800, Praveen Singh <praveen@medtechlabs.com> wrote:
> Markus — thanks for the quick review. A couple clarifications:
> - PHI: initial POC will not include PHI; it will use de-identified telemetry. Production may need PHI later; we can treat that as a separate scope.
> - Insurance: Samir from Procurement can handle the numbers if you need a contact.
>
> Praveen

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Praveen Singh <praveen@medtechlabs.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 27 Feb 2028 09:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Discovery recap + next-step owners (shot across) — request: redline lane & ETA

Hi all — quick note from Security/CS perspective:
- Since PHI is not part of the POC, we can proceed with our standard SOC 2 + penetration test evidence. I attached our standard evidence packet for procurement review.
- If they later want PHI in production, we will need the DPA and a security addendum; Markus, can you keep the DPA review in parallel as discussed?

Attachment: medtech_ndaconfidential.pdf (PDF, 420 KB)

Next steps checklist:
- Ben: schedule the cost-model meeting with Mira (week of Mar 6).
- Hannah: route canonical MSA to legal@redwood.com, cc Markus, and add Procurement contact (procurement@medtechlabs.com).
- Markus: produce initial redline within 3 business days of canonical receipt.
- Praveen / Asha: confirm if any local/regulatory constraints for production (data residency specifics).

Evelyn Hart
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
